description: Read a file with optional symbol-skeleton folding. Without folding behaves like read_file; with folding large contents are reduced to signatures and structure. Folding is skipped silently when the code-context service is unavailable.
name: read_file_folded

fold.description: Fold the content into a symbol skeleton when the service is available (default false)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

path.description: Path to the file (relative paths resolve against the execution working directory)
